description: Wander is a hospitality company that offers luxury smart vacation-home bookings and software for property operators under the WanderOS brand. Its public website includes booking information, help content, and AI-friendly markdown property data.
summary: wander.com exposes a public MCP endpoint at `https://wander.com/mcp` and public HTTP markdown property pages at `https://www.wander.com/property/{property-slug}.md`; no authenticated developer API, GraphQL API, or CLI was found on this domain.
